detail.longDescription: Using Spawn, I've been building The Velvet Point, a rainy-night backgammon club you play in the browser (desktop or phone). You can play the house opponents or real people, and chat at the tables. You will also get analytical (as well as snarky) comments from the AI opponents. Social features, leaderboards (ratings, PR, chips) also baked in. Has a review feature to show the best moves after your move. So no "hint" or tutoring before the move. I think you will learn better when you make a mistake - making a mistake will give your brain the feedback you need to learn better. Uses gnubg's neural nets & bear-off tables in the background, ported to run in the browser. It's open source ( https://github.com/ile/the-velvet-point ). Play here: https://www.spawn.co/@ilkkah/the-velvet-point I'd love feedback. There may be bugs (hopefully just minor ones).
